approach: Reference architecture outline for Command-Line Calculator: Build an interactive calculator that supports common arithmetic operations and validates user input.

implementation_steps: Implement and test: Parse operands without panicking on malformed input..
Implement and test: Support add, subtract, multiply, and divide..
Implement and test: Handle division by zero and unknown operations..
Implement and test: Separate parsing, calculation, and display into functions..
stretch_features: Add a small expression grammar with a clearly documented scope.
Add a test matrix for numeric boundaries.
reference_outline.quality_gate: Run cargo fmt, cargo clippy, cargo test, and relevant integration/target tests in a clean environment before reviewing for publication.

review_checklist: Verify each required feature against the 100-point rubric.
Run relevant tests on the declared stable toolchain and target.
Review security, ownership, external service failure, and shutdown paths.
Do not publish this solution outline as a complete production implementation without expert review.
